∀ {Error : Type} (manifest : Minidregg.Compiler.SemanticManifest.Manifest) (plan : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Plan) (runner : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.PlanRunner Error), (Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.run manifest plan runner).IsVerified → plan.manifestEncoding = manifest.canonicalEncoding ∧ ∀ instruction ∈ plan.instructions, ∃ response, runner instruction = Except.ok response ∧ ∃ clause, manifest.lookupClause instruction.clauseId = Option.some clause ∧ instruction.call.FullyWellFormed ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.PublicPrefixExact instruction response ∧ instruction.call.Accepts response.totalWires

∀ (descriptor : Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintDescriptor Minidregg.Compiler.BabyBear) (gate : Minidregg.Compiler.DGate Minidregg.Compiler.BabyBear), Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.dGateInBoundsCheck descriptor gate = Bool.true ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.DWire.bounded descriptor.nWires gate.a ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.DWire.bounded descriptor.nWires gate.b ∧ descriptor.nVars ≤ gate.out ∧ gate.out < descriptor.nWires
∀ (bound : ℕ) (wire : Minidregg.Compiler.DWire Minidregg.Compiler.BabyBear), Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.dWireBoundedCheck bound wire = Bool.true ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.DWire.bounded bound wire

∀ (manifest : Minidregg.Compiler.SemanticManifest.Manifest) (instruction : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Instruction) (response : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.KernelResponse instruction), ¬instruction.call.Accepts response.totalWires → ∀ (certificate : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.CertifiedResponse manifest instruction response), Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.checkInstruction manifest instruction response ≠ Sum.inr certificate

∀ (descriptor : Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintDescriptor Minidregg.Compiler.BabyBear) (wireValues : ℕ → Minidregg.Compiler.BabyBear), Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.descriptorHoldsCheck descriptor wireValues = Bool.true ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.descriptorHolds descriptor wireValues
∀ (n : ℕ) (check : Fin n → Bool), Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.finAll n check = Bool.true ↔ ∀ (index : Fin n), check index = Bool.true

∀ {Error : Type} (manifest : Minidregg.Compiler.SemanticManifest.Manifest) (plan : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Plan) (runner : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.PlanRunner Error) (instruction : Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Instruction) (rest : List Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Instruction) (error : Error), plan.manifestEncoding = manifest.canonicalEncoding → plan.instructions = instruction :: rest → runner instruction = Except.error error → Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.run manifest plan runner = Minidregg.Compiler.NativeKernelPlan.Outcome.blocked error
